review_focus:
Item P59 (#617), phase 5. The ADDENDUM-06 entry is the spec:
### P59 `pr(tab)`, `pr_status`, the stack and the GitHub senders

- Branch: `epic/p59-pr-resources`. Lanes: S, D, DS, U, P. Model: `opus`. Depends on: P58.1, P58.2 (the chain order: both hold D and U), P55.3 (DS is free once the sidebar track ends).
- **Goal:** the PR card, merge box, GitHub status and stack read resources, and no GitHub command picks its tab from the App.
- **Done when:** `pr(tab)` is built from the PR section; `pr_status(remote, number)` from the status cache through the desktop owner; the stack is part of `pr(tab)`: `PrSection` gains it, and a service command for the stack refresh runs `gh_stack::load_from` off the actor thread, as `refresh_stack_impl` (`commands.rs:3345`) runs it off the App lock, so the actor stays its one writer and a stack change moves the PR section's revision (decided: the stack is per tab, refreshed with the PR and read only by the PR card, so its own resource would add a fetch to every card render); `active_tab_command` (`commands.rs:6895`), `send_for_active_tab` (`:6904`) and the flag path's comment tick `spawn_service_comment_sync` (`main.rs:812`, which picks its PR with `app.try_lock()` and `active_pr_identity(guard.tab(), &pr_cache)` at `:823`–`:826` and its target with `active_tab_command(&guard)` at `:834`) take the tab from the `tabs` resource and its content (the document preview check sits inside `request_file_preview` and is P56.2's); `github_comment_builders.rs` imports `NewGitHubComment` from `er_engine::github_post_session` (`github_post_session.rs:29`) instead of `er_engine::app` (`:7`); it is the same type, which `er_engine::app` re-exports through `app/state/github_post.rs:22`–`:24` and `app/mod.rs:25`; the helpers in `gh_pr_actions.rs` that outlive `run_github_pr_action` take `DesktopState`, and `run_github_pr_action_blocking`'s App reads (`active_github_key(&app, state)` at `gh_pr_actions.rs:79`–`:80`, the snapshot at `:101`–`:102`) give way to the `tabs` resource and an `Ack`; the GitHub status loop (`main.rs:1427`) takes its PR identity from `tabs` and `prs(remote)` instead of `active_pr_identity(g.tab(), …)` (`:1436`); the 13 GitHub command functions (12 names; `submit_github_pr_decision` has two bodies) go through `er_send`; `reply_to_github_thread`, which goes through `route_annotation` today, carries the `TabKey` and the painted view and follows P58.2's refusal rule (an unlisted key answers `NotFound`, a stale view is refused); the entry stops reading `pr`, `github` and `stack`.
- **Planted breaks:** a GitHub post that reads the App's active tab fails the held-App-mutex test; a status loop that reads the App tab fails the same test; with the App locked, the comment tick still picks its PR from `tabs` and sends the sync, and the `try_lock` plant skips the tick and fails the same test; a status refresh that does not bump `pr_status` fails; a stack refresh that does not move the PR section's revision fails; a merge pinned to a stale head fails the head test; a `reply_to_github_thread` painted in another mode of the same tab, or naming a key the registry no longer lists, is refused, and dropping the view comparison or the registry lookup fails the reply test.
- **Fallback split:** P59.1 `pr(tab)`, `pr_status` and the stack; P59.2 the GitHub senders and commands.
- Size: L.

Check: every done-when item exists and each planted break fails; flag-off unchanged; new commands satisfy er::command_shape and its allow-list only shrinks; source scans hold; History, Conflicts and Hidden keep the snapshot fallback until P56.3; each PR under 1,500.
